evidence_items.explanation: The study reports reduced hiring at exposed establishments and no detectable aggregate employment relationship in its earlier US data. Neither finding counts gross jobs eliminated worldwide through October 2022; available_at conservatively uses the last day of the stated February 2022 revision month.

evidence_items.explanation: The experiments show that success on one formulation of a causal-language task need not transfer to another. This supports concern about robustness, but a June evaluation of selected models does not establish an October-wide absence of comprehension.

unresolved_gaps: No representative estimate of gross AI-caused job displacement through October 16, 2022 was established.
The employment study covers an earlier US period and cannot settle the worldwide claim.
Reduced hiring is evidence of labor substitution, but not a count of people whose jobs were replaced.
The comprehension evidence covers selected models and tasks, without a common threshold for the claimed general capability.
